upstream.prompt: Not returned by original tool; not invented
upstream.status: Historical tool record retained. The user-supplied original has matching dimensions but different bytes; byte identity is not asserted.

intake.recipe: Unmodified uploaded PNG is the production input. Crops use original-image pixels; no resized sheet or lossy intake is sampled.

processing.coordinates: original PNG pixels, rectangles left/top/right/bottom exclusive; quads upper-left/lower-left/lower-right/upper-right
processing.rectification: Pillow QUAD samples original perspective-bearing texture patches directly; flat crops use identity rectification

actor_ground_shadow.algorithm: exterior-connected neutral-gray removal restricted to bottom 18 percent of original actor crop
actor_ground_shadow.protection: pixels above foot band unchanged; dark shoes and colored hems stop flood fill

processing.downsample: LANCZOS to 64x64 for textures; aspect-fit decals with 2px margin; actors 48x64 with 3px margin
processing.alpha: binary threshold >127; fully transparent pixels normalized to zero RGBA
processing.tile_edges: opposite texture edge RGB averaged identically
processing.atlas: 192x256 RGBA, four 48x64 frames in front/back/left/right rows; deterministic derived foot swing only
processing.runtime_sampling: nearest; texture mipmaps enabled, actor mipmaps disabled

reference.purpose: copyrighted visual research only; no pixels sampled into runtime assets

concept.purpose: composition, density and lighting reference; never a scene image

upstream_archive_scope: Both user-supplied original PNGs retained without re-encoding; historical upstream hash mismatch documented.
